exposure: Extensive dome-like laminoplasty using en bloc resection of the C2 inner lamina
outcome: Neck and arm visual analog scale (VAS)
cohort: A total of 36 patients with severe cord compression behind the C2 body, diagnosed with ossification of the posterior longitudinal ligament or congenital stenosis with spondylosis, underwent extensive dome-like laminoplasty.
finding: Extensive dome-like laminoplasty significantly increased the canal diameter behind C2 and improved clinical scores, demonstrating satisfactory surgical outcomes with rare complications for patients with severe cord compression.
